voice_description: An elderly female witch around eighty years old with a thin mid-to-high pitched voice, dry scratchy timbre, gentle rasp, and naturally creaky age. Clever, eccentric, suspicious, slyly humorous, and slightly wicked. Her rhythm is uneven but natural, with excellent intelligibility. She should sound distinctly old and witchlike without becoming a caricature.
direction: The witch speaks more softly and intimately while retaining her aged rasp and creaky timbre. She sounds unexpectedly kind but still cautious and mysterious.

text: There is something your mother never told you. That little silver necklace was not merely a gift. It belonged to the first queen of the valley, and if it has begun glowing again, then something very old has finally awakened.
